transitive)Integrity hash — a cryptographic fingerprint of the exact
bytes downloaded. If a registry is compromised and someone swaps
the tarball, install fails. Security package.json can't provide.

This is a supply-chain security measure — a malicious package could otherwise run arbitrary code at install time via postinstall.
